claim.quote: This is the first observation of $C\!P$ violation in the decay of charm hadrons.

date.quote: [Submitted on 20 Mar 2019 (v1), last revised 31 May 2019 (this version, v2)]

key_value_text.quote: Combining these with previous LHCb results leads to $$\Delta A_{C\!P} = ( -15.4 \pm 2.9) \times 10^{-4},$$ where the uncertainty includes both statistical and systematic contributions.

name: Observation of CP violation in charm decays

significance.quote: The measured value differs from zero by more than five standard deviations.

summary.plain: LHCb found that charm particles and their antimatter partners decay in measurably different ways: the first observation of this matter-antimatter difference (CP violation) in the decay of charm hadrons. The same kind of difference had already been established for kaons and B mesons.
summary.technical: Measurement of the CP-asymmetry difference ΔA_CP between D⁰→K⁻K⁺ and D⁰→π⁻π⁺ decays using about 6 fb⁻¹ of 13 TeV pp data; combined with previous LHCb results, ΔA_CP = (−15.4±2.9)×10⁻⁴, which the paper says differs from zero by more than five standard deviations. The paper states this is the first observation of CP violation in the decay of charm hadrons.

title: Observation of CP Violation in Charm Decays
why_it_matters: The paper says CP violation had been established in the K- and B-meson systems but that its observation in the charm sector had not been achieved despite decades of searches. It reports the result as consistent with, although in magnitude at the upper end of, Standard Model expectations (10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³), and says further measurements will help establish whether it is consistent with the Standard Model or indicates new dynamics in the up-quark sector.
